tool_args.rationale: The polynomial was refuted on fresh confirmation, but that does not refute a siphon law; the subsequent failures were implementation errors, not scientific evidence. The bridge notes support a saturating two-layer siphon with sink-gradient inhibition and either an open square-root branch or linear leak. Fit each supported form numerically to all paid rows and select the lowest-residual form; no additional probe is needed before this corrected confirmation attempt.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven paid rows already span the input and sink-gradient dimensions; the recalled siphon with one of three supported branch terms is numerically estimable without adding trajectory measurements.
Fresh confirmation explicitly refuted this stationary polynomial model (RMSE 1.201337).
The observations have constant H and mem_conv, and the available rows align with the bridge siphon mechanism; buying a larger trajectory batch is not warranted yet.
It does not distinguish the supported flux-law mechanisms and is explicitly unnecessary.
